protocol.test_use: release acceptance/descriptive paired comparison only; never refit or change validation selection

gui_validation.notice: Three extra nominal GUI cases; not part of the 48 calibration/validation/test episodes.

audit.freeze_order_evidence: Explicit trace UTC is recorded on _reset entry before initialization/physics; not inferred by subtracting episode wall duration.
limitations: Recorded aggregate mass, partitions, timing, commands, action dictionaries and provenance are independently checked; raw particle positions/velocities are not serialized, so full-state finite checks remain the frozen solver collector's assertions.
Volume is privileged particle-label geometry with 0.042875mL nominal quantum and float32 mass consistency, not calibrated camera/scale accuracy or physical hardware validation.

Reset jitter is sampled within 0.03 spacing before a float32 position cast; the realized coordinate difference can exceed that nominal bound by the geometry-derived half-ULP rounding allowance recorded per trace.
Three hand-designed parameter configurations and fresh initial-state jitter/viscosity seeds provide local calibration evidence, not neural/RL policy learning or broad sim-to-real generalization.
Baseline goal-clamping can cause finite-difference acceleration/velocity discontinuities; these are reported without retroactively changing its predeclared validity or release criteria.
Failures, timeouts, overdoses and controller precision-failure statuses remain in every recomputed group metric; no outliers are removed.
UTC/checksum provenance establishes the recorded ordering and immutable artifact consistency; it is not an external trusted timestamp or independent hardware measurement.
Hand-designed feedback structure plus three predeclared local configurations, not neural/RL policy learning.
Six calibration and six validation target/seed conditions each use two initial-state seeds; test uses nine conditions and three fresh seeds.
Volumes are privileged particle-mass truth at 0.042875mL quantum, not vision or a calibrated hardware scale.
Kinematic pre-grasp and the existing bounded path; no friction grasp or fluid torque feedback.
All precision failures, timeouts and inaccurate doses remain in traces/journal; test cannot change parameters or recommendation.
Three extra visible nominal GUI runs are separate from the 48 formal episodes.
Public portable source conversion changes source hashes; do not resume local logs with transformed source.
Measured wall seconds depend on concurrent GPU/application load.
Baseline legacy path endpoint snaps are separately diagnosed; original protocol flags are retained.
